# kea_dhcp4_subnet (Resource)

Manages a DHCPv4 subnet in the Kea DHCP server, including its pools and DHCP options.

Every change is saved to the configuration file of the server with `config-write`.

Timers left unset (`valid_lifetime`, `min_valid_lifetime`, `max_valid_lifetime`, `renew_timer` and `rebind_timer`) take the value Kea derives from the global configuration.

**Important:** Requires the `subnet_cmds` hook library.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Basic subnet with one pool
resource "kea_dhcp4_subnet" "office" {
  id     = 10
  subnet = "192.0.2.0/24"

  pools {
    pool = "192.0.2.100 - 192.0.2.200"
  }

  option_data {
    name = "routers"
    data = "192.0.2.1"
  }

  option_data {
    name = "domain-name-servers"
    data = "192.0.2.53, 192.0.2.54"
  }
}

# Subnet reached through relay agents, with lease timers
resource "kea_dhcp4_subnet" "branch" {
  id     = 20
  subnet = "198.51.100.0/24"
  relay  = ["198.51.100.1"]

  valid_lifetime = 3600
  renew_timer    = 900
  rebind_timer   = 1800

  pools {
    pool = "198.51.100.10 - 198.51.100.99"
  }

  # Pool restricted to a client class, with its own options
  pools {
    pool           = "198.51.100.128/26"
    client_classes = ["voip-phones"]

    option_data {
      name = "tftp-server-name"
      data = "198.51.100.5"
    }
  }

  option_data {
    name = "routers"
    data = "198.51.100.1"
  }
}

# Directly attached subnet with PXE boot and DNS updates
resource "kea_dhcp4_subnet" "lab" {
  id        = 30
  subnet    = "203.0.113.0/24"
  interface = "eth1"

  next_server    = "203.0.113.5"
  boot_file_name = "pxelinux.0"

  reservations_global    = false
  reservations_in_subnet = true

  ddns_send_updates      = true
  ddns_qualifying_suffix = "lab.example.org."

  pools {
    pool = "203.0.113.100 - 203.0.113.200"
  }

  user_context = jsonencode({
    site  = "lab"
    owner = "network-team"
  })
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Subnet ID. Must be unique within the server. Kea only assigns IDs itself when no subnet has an explicit ID, so the ID is always set explicitly.
- `subnet` (String) Subnet prefix in CIDR notation (e.g., `192.0.2.0/24`).

### Optional

- `boot_file_name` (String) Boot file name for network booting (`file` field in DHCP packet).
- `client_classes` (Set of String) Restrict the subnet to clients in at least one of these classes.
- `ddns_generated_prefix` (String) Prefix of generated client names.
- `ddns_override_client_update` (Boolean) Update forward DNS even when the client asks to do it itself.
- `ddns_override_no_update` (Boolean) Update DNS even when the client asks the server not to.
- `ddns_qualifying_suffix` (String) Suffix appended to partial client names.
- `ddns_replace_client_name` (String) When to replace the name sent by the client: `never`, `always`, `when-present` or `when-not-present`.
- `ddns_send_updates` (Boolean) Send DNS updates for leases in this subnet.
- `ddns_ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds of the DNS records for leases in this subnet.
- `ddns_update_on_renew` (Boolean) Update DNS on every lease renewal, not only when the lease is new or changes.
- `evaluate_additional_classes` (Set of String) Classes evaluated after the subnet is selected (`evaluate-additional-classes`, formerly `require-client-classes`).
- `interface` (String) Name of the interface the subnet is directly reachable on. The interface must exist on the server.
- `max_valid_lifetime` (Number) Maximum lease lifetime in seconds a client may request. Defaults to `valid_lifetime`.
- `min_valid_lifetime` (Number) Minimum lease lifetime in seconds a client may request. Defaults to `valid_lifetime`.
- `next_server` (String) Next server address for network booting (`siaddr` field in DHCP packet).
- `option_data` (Block Set) DHCP options sent to clients in this subnet, overriding global options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--option_data))
- `pools` (Block List) Address pools of the subnet. Kea keeps pools sorted by address, so an imported subnet lists them in that order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--pools))
- `rebind_timer` (Number) T2 timer in seconds (Option 59). Defaults to the value derived from the global configuration.
- `relay` (Set of String) Addresses of relay agents that forward requests for this subnet (`relay.ip-addresses`).
- `renew_timer` (Number) T1 timer in seconds (Option 58). Defaults to the value derived from the global configuration.
- `reservations_global` (Boolean) Look up global host reservations for clients in this subnet.
- `reservations_in_subnet` (Boolean) Look up host reservations made for this subnet.
- `reservations_out_of_pool` (Boolean) Assume reserved addresses are outside the pools, which speeds up allocation. Only used when `reservations_in_subnet` is `true`.
- `server_hostname` (String) Server hostname for network booting (`sname` field in DHCP packet).
- `user_context` (String) Arbitrary JSON data stored with this subnet.
- `valid_lifetime` (Number) Lease lifetime in seconds. Defaults to the value derived from the global configuration.

### Read-Only

- `shared_network_name` (String) Name of the shared network the subnet belongs to, if any. Shared networks are not managed by this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--option_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `option_data`

Optional:

- `always_send` (Boolean) Always send this option, even if not requested by the client.
- `client_classes` (Set of String) Only send this option to clients in these classes.
- `code` (Number) Option code (0-255). Required if `name` is not set.
- `csv_format` (Boolean) When `true` (default), data is comma-separated values. When `false`, data is raw bytes as hex (`dead` or `0xdead`), colon/space-delimited octets (`de:ad` or `de ad`), or a quoted string (`'text'`).
- `data` (String) Option value. Format depends on `csv_format`.
- `name` (String) Option name (e.g., `domain-name-servers`). Required if `code` is not set.
- `never_send` (Boolean) Never send this option to the client.
- `space` (String) Option space. Defaults to `dhcp4`.


<a id="nestedblock--pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pools`

Required:

- `pool` (String) Address range, either `first - last` (e.g., `192.0.2.10 - 192.0.2.100`) or a prefix (e.g., `192.0.2.128/26`).

Optional:

- `client_classes` (Set of String) Restrict the pool to clients in at least one of these classes.
- `evaluate_additional_classes` (Set of String) Classes evaluated after an address is allocated from the pool.
- `option_data` (Block Set) DHCP options sent to clients that get an address from this pool. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--pools--option_data))

<a id="nestedblock--pools--option_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pools.option_data`

Optional:

- `always_send` (Boolean) Always send this option, even if not requested by the client.
- `client_classes` (Set of String) Only send this option to clients in these classes.
- `code` (Number) Option code (0-255). Required if `name` is not set.
- `csv_format` (Boolean) When `true` (default), data is comma-separated values. When `false`, data is raw bytes as hex (`dead` or `0xdead`), colon/space-delimited octets (`de:ad` or `de ad`), or a quoted string (`'text'`).
- `data` (String) Option value. Format depends on `csv_format`.
- `name` (String) Option name (e.g., `domain-name-servers`). Required if `code` is not set.
- `never_send` (Boolean) Never send this option to the client.
- `space` (String) Option space. Defaults to `dhcp4`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Subnets are imported by ID
terraform import kea_dhcp4_subnet.office 10
```
